name: 3x3 Permutation Matrix Trace Isomorphism
description: Replaces the affine transformations with 3x3 permutation matrices where the trace of their product is 3 if they differ and 0 if they are identical. This perfectly encodes the 2-coloring constraint while forcing models to perform matrix multiplication to discover it, which they often hallucinate or misinterpret as requiring a complex matrix-based algorithm.
